PART III – LANDSPART III – LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land described below will be required for a public purpose and will be acquired under Land Acquisition Act.

Allotment of Land depicted in Advance Tracing No. KE/RMB/2020/52 dated 17.06.2020 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Village of Kiriwandeniya in Grama Niladhari Division of No. 09, Kiriwandeniya in Medde Mediliya Pattu Minor Division in Divisional Secretary’s Division of Rambukkana in Kegalle District in Sabaragamuwa Province:

01. Lot A - Pansalawaththa and Moragahamula Waththa - Extent: 0.0253 Hectare North: Pansal Waththa, Moragahamula Waththa and Road (Pradeshiya Sabha); East: Road (Pradeshiya Sabha), Pansal Waththa and Moragahamulawaththa; South: PansalaWaththa, Moragahamulawaththa; West: PansalaWaththa, Moragahamulawaththa.
K. D. LAL KANTHA, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation.
My No.: 4-3/5/2019/HA/555.Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation,“Mihikatha Medura”,1200/6, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla.19th December, 2025.

PART III – GAZETTE EXTRAORDINARY OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA – 13.02.20262A
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the servitude decribed in paragraph I herein below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act, In paragraph II, it is described from which land that the said servitude is acquired.
SCHEDULE

I. Description of servitude.– Acquisition of the servitude right of a lot of land for laying transmission pipes to Gallenawatta service reservoir of Pathadumbara Integrated Water Supply Project - Kandy North and laying distribution pipes from there.

II. Description of the Land.– The lot of land in the following names and extent described morefully in advance tracing bearing No. Maha/TMP/2021/673 dated 21.12.2021 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the village of Gallenawatta Janapadaya in the Grama Niladhari Division
of Gallenawatta (364) in Minor Division of Udapalatha East Korale in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Thumpane in the District of Kandy in the Central Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot A - Gallenawaththa- Extent: 0.0112 Hectare North: Stairs and Pradeshiya Sabha Road; East: Pradeshiya Sabha Road and Gallenawatta Janapadaya claimed by M.G. Leelawathi; South: Gallenawatta Janapadaya claimed by M.G. Leelawathi and Pradeshiya Sabha Road; West: Pradeshiya Sabha Road and Stairs.

K. D. Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation. My No.: 4-3/18/2021/WS/161.Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation,“Mihikatha Medura”,1200/6, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla.19th December, 2025.
